timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) allowed for graceful shutdown before forceful termination.

listen_addr.description: IP address or hostname the service should bind to. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

listen_port.description: TCP port the service listens on.

work_dir.description: Working directory where the service starts and writes runtime data.

user.description: System user account under which the service runs for security isolation.

group.description: System group associated with the user account.

nofile_limit.description: Maximum number of open file descriptors allowed for the service process.

nproc_limit.description: Maximum number of processes/threads allowed for the service.

env_vars.description: Custom environment variables to pass to the service (e.g., DATABASE_URL, LOG_LEVEL).

key.description: Environment variable name (must be alphanumeric with underscores).

extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments to pass to the service binary (space-separated).

selinux_context.description: Optional SELinux security context (e.g., 'httpd_sys_content_t') for labeling files or processes.

restart_policy.description: When to automatically restart the service: 'always', 'on-failure', 'on-abnormal', 'on-abort', or 'never'.

restart_sec.description: Delay (in seconds) before attempting to restart the service after failure.
